config.notes: CourseLoop handbook (coursehandbook.mq.edu.au/2026/courses and /2026/doubledegree). Course data sits in the page script __NEXT_DATA__ under props.pageProps.pageContent: cricos_code and title (identity), ielts_overall_score (IELTS overall; band scores in ielts_reading/writing/listening/speaking_score), course_duration_in_years, offering list (location, mode, admission_calendar = Session 1 / Session 2 / Term names, no months; start_date empty), fees list (one entry per fee type: international_fee_paying, domestic_fee_paying, domestic_csp, each with estimated_annual_fee and fee_per_credit_point, in varying order). The handbook does not print months or fees in its page text, so intakes and the international fee cannot be read with the current adapter fields: the fee needs a page-data filter by fee type, and the session-to-month mapping sits on a central key-dates page. Only pages kept from a plain fetch carry __NEXT_DATA__; the 149 handbook pages kept from Firecrawl (1 Oct) do not. Older handbook.mq.edu.au (2014-2019) and www.mq.edu.au course pages are read by the general reader.
